nodes.prompt: TASK: Check whether D:/Projects/pi-antigravity is ready for offline V3.1 verification. DELIVERABLE: Write a short report at node:os.tmpdir()/pi-antigravity-v31-{{key}}/preflight.txt containing STATUS=READY or STATUS=NOT_READY, the current branch and HEAD, and the reason if not ready. SCOPE: Read only this repository's Git state, package.json, and the existence of scripts/check-v3-1-lock-stress.ts and scripts/test-health-gate-open.ts; write only this run's report using apply_patch. NEVER switch branches, change Git state, inspect live OmO data, or call a provider. VERIFY: Both V3.1 scripts exist, test:health names test-health-gate-open.ts, and git ls-files -u is empty before reporting READY; otherwise report NOT_READY. STOP WHEN: The report exists with an evidence-backed status.

DELIVERABLE: Write node:os.tmpdir()/pi-antigravity-v31-{{key}}/static.txt with STATUS=PASS or STATUS=FAIL and the exit code of each command. SCOPE: FIRST read preflight.txt. If its status is not READY, write STATUS=NOT_READY and STOP WITHOUT RUNNING COMMANDS. Otherwise run only bun run typecheck, bun run lint, and bun run security-check from the repository root; write only this run's report using apply_patch. NEVER change tracked files, touch live OmO state, or make provider requests. VERIFY: Each of the three commands exits 0 for PASS. STOP WHEN: The report records all applicable results.

TASK: Run the offline recovery, V3/V3.1 health, and Claude suites in D:/Projects/pi-antigravity. DELIVERABLE: Write node:os.tmpdir()/pi-antigravity-v31-{{key}}/health.txt with STATUS=PASS or STATUS=FAIL, each command's exit code, and scenario counts. SCOPE: FIRST read preflight.txt. If its status is not READY, write STATUS=NOT_READY and STOP WITHOUT RUNNING COMMANDS. Otherwise run only bun run test:recovery, bun run test:health, and bun run test:claude from the repository root; write only this run's report using apply_patch. The health and Claude scripts carry the offline preload; do not contact a provider or read live OmO files. VERIFY: All three commands exit 0 and health output includes the Windows gate test and health stream cases for PASS. STOP WHEN: The report records the three results.

TASK: Verify upstream routing, discovery, pricing, usage, commands, SSE, and synthetic account loading in D:/Projects/pi-antigravity. DELIVERABLE: Write node:os.tmpdir()/pi-antigravity-v31-{{key}}/upstream.txt with STATUS=PASS or STATUS=FAIL and an exit code for each command. SCOPE: FIRST read preflight.txt. If its status is not READY, write STATUS=NOT_READY and STOP WITHOUT RUNNING COMMANDS; if an existing upstream.txt lists commands already run in this same run, preserve that disclosure in the report. Otherwise run bun --preload ./scripts/v3-offline.ts separately for scripts/test-model-routing.ts, scripts/test-model-discovery.ts, scripts/test-pricing.ts, scripts/test-usage-loading.ts, scripts/test-command-dispatch.ts, and scripts/test-stream-sse.ts; also run bun scripts/check-v3-load.mjs; write only this run's report using apply_patch. NEVER change Git state, use live credentials, or call a provider. VERIFY: Each command exits 0 and synthetic load reports zero provider requests and writes for PASS. STOP WHEN: The report records all seven applicable results.

TASK: Run the Windows multiprocess V3.1 health stress harness from D:/Projects/pi-antigravity after the health lane passes. DELIVERABLE: Write node:os.tmpdir()/pi-antigravity-v31-{{key}}/stress.txt with STATUS=PASS or STATUS=FAIL and per-tier ordinary-success counts, expected busy counts, and networkAttempts. SCOPE: FIRST read health.txt. If its status is not PASS, write STATUS=NOT_READY and STOP WITHOUT RUNNING COMMANDS. Otherwise run only bun scripts/check-v3-1-lock-stress.ts 3 from the repository root; write only this run's report using apply_patch. The harness must use its private synthetic TEMP fixture. NEVER read live OmO state, change Git history, or contact a provider. VERIFY: Exit code 0 and summary JSON has ok=true, violation=null, networkAttempts=0, rounds=3, tiers 2/4/8/16, with ordinary successes 22/40/76/148 and two expected fail-closed busy probes per tier. STOP WHEN: The report records the harness verdict and four tier counts.

TASK: Independently verify the offline V3.1 run evidence in D:/Projects/pi-antigravity. DELIVERABLE: Write node:os.tmpdir()/pi-antigravity-v31-{{key}}/summary.txt with STATUS=PASS only if all five upstream reports are present and their evidence meets each node's VERIFY contract; write STATUS=NOT_READY if preflight was NOT_READY, or STATUS=FAIL for missing or failing evidence. SCOPE: Read only this run's preflight.txt, static.txt, health.txt, upstream.txt, stress.txt and repository Git state; write only summary.txt using apply_patch. NEVER rerun tests, switch branches, change code, or access live OmO files. VERIFY: Check recorded exit codes, all four stress tiers and zero network attempts, and confirm current HEAD/branch still match preflight and git ls-files -u is empty. STOP WHEN: The summary states an evidence-backed PASS, NOT_READY, or FAIL with reasons.
